long_biography.plain_text:
Ronald Grünberg studied law at Lausanne before becoming general manager of his family's appliance-distribution company. After its sale into BSH, he led local marketing and sales and sat on the executive board. His career combined inherited equity with sustained operating responsibility across home-appliance distribution and manufacturing.

After retiring from BSH in 2018, Grünberg retained an investment role in industrial technology. He became a 35 per cent shareholder in 3BFAB, an Istanbul business producing its own three-dimensional printers, software and resins. He is also an authorised member of the company's active American affiliate.
